item.description:
### Added - **Amp support.** Perch now shows your [Amp](https://ampcode.com) CLI sessions in the fleet — which project each thread is in, whether it's running or idle, the tool it's using right now, its title, and an elapsed-turn timer — with a "finished" notification when a turn completes, and click-to-focus for the terminal it's running in. Zero setup: Perch reads Amp's own logs and writes nothing. Works on the Mac, iPhone and Apple Watch. - **Amp usage bars.** While an Amp session is open, Perch shows your Amp plan's usage meters and renewal countdown in the dropdown — and on your iPhone, Apple Watch and widgets — with a warning when a meter runs low. Uses the login the Amp CLI already has; nothing to set up. Turn it off with `defaults write com.inkryptislabs.perch perch.ampUsage -bool false`. Free-tier accounts get their meter and credits balance too, and the plan name now shows correctly next to the AMP label. - **Amp in Stats.** The Stats dashboard — heatmap, streaks, sessions, active days, longest session — now counts your Amp threads, with its own filter segment on the Mac, iPhone and Apple Watch. Token totals honestly exclude Amp (it records none), the same way Cursor's are handled. - **Amp sessions update instantly — and can now ask for you.** Perch installs a small plugin into Amp (removable, and it never touches your other Amp settings) that reports state the moment it changes instead of every few seconds — including when Amp is **waiting for your approval**, which now shows as "Waiting for you" with a needs-you notification on your Mac and phone, just like Claude Code. What your agents say and do stays private: the plugin sends session status only, never conversation content. - **Perch Pro.** Subscribe in the Perch app on your iPhone and paste the subscription ID into Perch on your Mac — either on the unlock screen or in Settings — and it unlocks Perch and lets you read your agents' conversations from your phone. A subscription unlocks the whole Mac app, so you don't need a licence key as well. Unlinking only forgets the ID on this Mac; it never cancels a subscription, which is managed in the App Store.
### Changed - **Reading conversations on your phone is now part of Perch Pro.** Everything the $29 licence has always done is unchanged and still yours forever — the menu bar, the fleet, notifications, approvals and push. Reading transcripts on your phone has never been available outside TestFlight, so nobody loses anything they had. - Background push to your iPhone still needs a Perch licence. A subscription on its own doesn't carry one yet, and Settings says so where the switch is.
